component.name: Nacre
component.summary: Modern antivirus for Linux, powered by ClamAV

description.p: Nacre is a friendly GTK4 front end for the ClamAV antivirus engine.

ul.li: Quick, full system and custom scans with live progress
Quarantine, restore or permanently delete threats
A 30-day activity log of every scan and action

description.p: New name: Nacre. New option to shut the computer down automatically when a full scan is done.
